title: Stop Drinking Your Calories
body: Researchers at Purdue gave people 450 extra calories a day as jelly beans or soda, and when they ate the jelly beans, they ate less food to make up for it. But when they drank the soda, they didn't eat any less and they gained weight. So look at the soda, juice, sweet tea, coffee drinks and beer you're drinking, because those calories aren't filling you up.
close: Try water, black coffee or zero calorie drinks instead.
youtube_description:
Stop drinking your calories.

Researchers at Purdue gave people 450 extra calories a day as jelly beans or soda, and when they ate the jelly beans, they ate less food to make up for it. But when they drank the soda, they didn't eat any less and they gained weight. So look at the soda, juice, sweet tea, coffee drinks and beer you're drinking, because those calories aren't filling you up.

Try water, black coffee or zero calorie drinks instead.
